headline: Iran aims to ban U.S. and Israeli ships from Strait of Hormuz and charge others a toll
context: Iran's parliament is reviewing a plan to ban ships linked to the U.S., Israel and other "hostile countries" from transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The Trump administration has rejected the plan.

sources.name: NPR
